Frames as Glamsterdam headliner EIP expected to be ratified at Thursday's ACDE call

eip_proposals_glamsterdam.highlight: EIP-7906 (Transaction Assertions via post-transaction frame + state-diff opcodes): Toni supports inclusion in Glamsterdam to avoid re-touching Frame Transactions later; recommendation to not commingle with BAL state diffs

ERC-1979 (key lifecycle standard for EIP-8141/EIP-8130): proposes common add/rotate/revoke key management with two tiers — recent-root (no state read, delayed revoke) vs. account state slot (instant revoke, one state read); cross-chain extension included

EIP-12301 (maxVerifyGas as mempool floor): proposes redefining maxVerifyGas from a hard cap to a protocol-guaranteed floor, letting individual nodes accept heavier verify transactions above that floor

frame_expiry_discussion.highlight: raxhvl proposed replacing the expiry VERIFY frame with a native transaction-level 'features' field (key-value pairs, canonical ordering); saves ~32 bytes vs. empty frame encoding

lightclient and Toni skeptical: expiry is already implementable via VERIFY frame without state dependency; no evidence enough other features exist to justify generalizing; design discussion deferred to Ethereum Magicians / EthMAC

action_items.action: raxhvl to post frame expiry / transaction features discussion to Frame Transaction EthMAC thread for async feedback
Client teams to submit Hegota non-headliner EIP preferences to Nixo and Ansgar ≥24 hours before Thursday's ACDE

decisions.decision: Toni recommends EIP-7906 (Transaction Assertions) be included in Glamsterdam; do not commingle assertion state diffs with BAL data
